text:
amelia (Design): quick sync on the Private setup preflight step. users keep asking whether we execute commands or send creds when they press "Run checks". want a clearer control label, fallback flow, and accessibility behavior.

ravi (UX): agree. propose renaming to "Run connectivity checks (recommended)" and adding a single clarifier line: "Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from its health-checker IPs. No credentials or commands are sent." Also unify CTAs: "Run from Redwood (recommended)" and "Run locally (manual)".

che (Eng): technical details: probe sequence = TCP handshake -> SSH probe on port 22 -> optional HTTP GET. originates from fixed IPv4 health-checker IPs (i'll post the CIDRs). we do not authenticate or run remote commands. local probe option will be a downloadable script that posts results to a signed, time-limited URL.

amelia (Design): UI asks: show discrete status chips for TCP/SSH/HTTP with color states and small icons. on failure display a concise remediation line and a "Troubleshoot" link that expands steps inline. prefer the phrase "permitted IPs" instead of "allowlist".

harper (Product): product decision: default toggle OFF for Private/on-prem, ON for hosted. local-run should be prominent for customers behind strict egress. also add a small "Privacy details" link under the toggle that opens a short blurb.

ravi (UX): accessibility: toggle must have aria-describedby that includes probe behavior + that no credentials are used. use a polite live region (role=status) for updates: announce "Connectivity checks running" then final state and suggested next step. when a check fails, move focus to the failing input and announce the error summary.

che (Eng): implementation note: returning a `probe_summary` array with items like "SSH: failed (timeout)" will let the UI render chips and logs. logs will redact any secrets; targets and IPs may appear in logs. local probe will explicitly avoid uploading local configs.

amelia (Design): proposed microcopy (compact):

"Run connectivity checks (recommended)"
"Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from our health-checker IPs to the host and port you provide. No credentials or commands are sent. If you cannot allow our IPs, download a local probe to run inside your network."

Inline error example:
"SSH check failed — could not reach bastion.acme.local:22. Verify outbound rules for permitted Redwood IPs or run the local probe."

Success chip: "Connectivity checks passed" (green)

harper (Product): can we keep the copy short and explicit like that. che, please add the CIDRs + a short privacy blurb we can link to. ravi, i'll rely on you for ARIA wording in the spec.

svc-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 2025-11-20T06:00Z 19

harper (Product): thanks all — amelia, ping when mocks are up; che, paste CIDRs here when ready.

amelia (Design): will push Figma mock with chips, toggles, and the download CTA later today.
